assertions.claim: tools/runner refuses a lane whose declared RAM does not fit host memory (avail - committed - candidate < 4608 MB reserve per ram-policy.md §4.1); exit code is 3, child process is never spawned, running tasks are untouched, and --override-admission allows launch despite tight RAM.

pass_control.scenario: Host avail=10000 MB, candidate=1000 MB (projected 9000 MB >= 4608 MB reserve).

fail_control.scenario: Host avail=5000 MB, candidate=1000 MB (projected 4000 MB < 4608 MB reserve).

override_control.scenario: Host avail=5000 MB, candidate=1000 MB, with --override-admission='test-emergency-override'.

assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Tested against injected avail memory; verified that runner returns exit code 3 and touches no spawn marker file when projected capacity breaches the 4608 MB reserve, while exit code 0 and child execution occur when capacity fits or override is passed.

assertions.claim: Expected wall time monotonically maps to RAM declarations per ram-policy.md §3.2 and boundary convention (boundary value belongs to the band it starts): <60s -> 768 MB, 60-600s -> 1792 MB, 600-1800s -> 3072 MB, >=1800s -> 4608 MB; explicit --ram-mb=N overrides.

fail_control.scenario: Asserting pre-T913 faulty expectation (e.g. 60s -> 768 MB or 1800s -> 1024 MB provider-based default).

assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Evaluated declared RAM against boundary values; proven to go red (exit code 1) when asserting the previous faulty provider-keyed values (which killed T912 at 10800s) or off-by-one boundary mapping.

assertions.claim: A lane that exceeds --max-wall is terminated via process group reap (SIGKILL), runner exits with code 124, and termination is attributed in the run record (killed_by='wall', signal=9, wall_budget=max_wall).
assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Spawned a silent sleep process exceeding --max-wall; observed runner terminate child after 1s, exit 124, and record killed_by='wall' with signal=9. Verified that an in-budget child exits 0 with killed_by=null.

assertions.claim: A process exceeding its RSS cap (--rss-cap-mb) is terminated by runner (exit 124, killed_by='rss', signal=9); while L3 sustained kernel memory pressure (WEIZIGO_KERNEL_PRESSURE_LEVEL=2) emits an ALARM without killing an in-budget process (exit 0, satisfying INV-1).
assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Executed memory allocations above and below cap: allocating 80 MB under 30 MB cap produced immediate termination (exit 124, killed_by='rss'), whereas in-budget allocation completed cleanly (exit 0). Injected kernel pressure level 2 verified ALARM emission without kill (INV-1).

assertions.claim: tools/runner records run_kind='dispatch' for top-level dispatches (untracked/runs/<task>.json) and run_kind='nested' for child test runs (untracked/runs/nested/<task>.<pid>-<epoch>.json), ensuring managent reap reads the true dispatch record without clobbering (T895).

pass_control.scenario: Top-level runner executing child that runs nested runner with identical MANAGENT_TASK_ID.

fail_control.scenario: Asserting nested run clobbered top-level record or misclassified kind.

assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Executed nested runner hierarchy inside scratch repository; verified that dispatch record retains run_kind='dispatch' while nested record in untracked/runs/nested/ is marked run_kind='nested'. If nested run had written to top-level slot, assertion fails with exit code 1.

assertions.claim: tools/runner automatically prepends ReleaseFast optimization (-Doptimize=ReleaseFast for zig build, -O ReleaseFast for zig run) when not explicitly set, preventing LLVM Debug mode memory exhaustion (incident 2026-07-29 actionable B-2).
assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Tested runner's CLI argument transformation against zig build/run commands; verified automatic insertion of ReleaseFast flags.

assertions.claim: tools/runner holds a caffeinate -i -w <runner_pid> assertion during execution on Darwin to prevent idle sleep, recording sleep_prevented=true in the run record (T927).

pass_control.scenario: tools/runner execution on Darwin with default sleep guard enabled.

fail_control.scenario: Asserting sleep_prevented=false on active Darwin run.

assertions.how_proved_can_fail: Verified that runner starts caffeinate assertion and writes sleep_prevented=true into the finalized run record.

uncovered_and_rationale.scope: Live process orphan kill (--sweep / --reap-orphans with SIGKILL)
uncovered_and_rationale.rationale: Sweeper live SIGKILL pass requires active untracked orphan processes on host. Destructive multi-pass orphan killing was tested for syntax/reap tree traversal in isolation rather than terminating live host processes.

Per ram-policy.md §4 and repo doctrine ('inject the reading, never exhaust the host'), memory pressure and available capacity are verified using injected environment variables (WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_AVAIL_MB, WEIZIGO_KERNEL_PRESSURE_LEVEL) rather than risking actual kernel panics.

uncovered_and_rationale.scope: Live external model provider API network calls
uncovered_and_rationale.rationale: Subagent prompt ingestion and wall-band mapping are tested deterministically without live network/API calls to ensure tests remain hermetic and reproducible offline.
